question: Can an acquired Native question selector revise obtaining information when the environmental utility changes, retain the useful reversal and use the actual information through a second Native selection?

experimental_design.current_sensory_information: Actual preview RAW at the fixed inherited site; query1 receives only its measured STATE. STATE1 can arise from +Z or +X and is deliberately ambiguous.
experimental_design.query_access: The legal question material request and its fixed signature gate a frozen prior RAW sample. The sample is a host technical register, not acquired Native memory or a fresh observation.
experimental_design.query2_codec: Prepared scale: actual registered bit0 -> material datum0; bit1 -> datum2. NoQuery -> declared material0. No expected answer is supplied.
experimental_design.query2_policy: Inherited Native bank is used with its actual learned difference, expected documented -1 but must be observed; not rewritten. Its generic nonfailure return is a fixed P0 disposal, not task learning.
experimental_design.query1_policy: A new legal unlearned Native TC support may be prepared in this same clone after full RAW/clock preflight. Its own efference receives the generic environmental outcome at a fixed hub/calendar. Fixed physical allocation is P0, not retrospective Python bank selection.
experimental_design.guard: PI09 SEM4 support remains. The new external resource domain, not removal of that support, makes information useful in some conditions.
experimental_design.resource_law: Before action, a 64-byte environmental resource is available in one of two fixed bins. In need/need_return the available bin follows the actual preview RAW bit; in bypass the resource is in bin0 independent of the bit. Native q2 actual valid command +1 selects bin1; valid command -1/0 selects bin0 using the declared fixed codec. NULL/rejected/invalid command selects no bin. The transducer attempts only that selected bin and transfers the resource if available; no fallback, target-based action choice or route correction.
experimental_design.useful_outcome: Actual resource transfer under the fixed law, with a valid admitted Native action. If FI is part of the sealed integration, its actual Native +1 output must also be available. A text counter alone is not a product.
experimental_design.objective_not_Native_input: Bin availability, regime labels, reserved labels, source case numbers and expected outcomes are evaluator/environment data. The Native policy receives only the declared physical inputs and subsequent generic consequence.

arms.real: Candidate Native choices and actual generic environmental failure at the fixed Q1 return interface.
arms.nonfailure: Paired complete clone; same legal Q1 return schedule but always nonfailure. This is not omission of all material return and does not match negative-class dose.
arms.yoked: Paired complete clone; the actual real18 outcome sequence is permuted by the prospective +5 modulo18 rule, fixed before the real outcomes and never optimized. Equal exogenous return-class total; endogenous query/request counts may diverge.

calibration_not_candidate_learning.minimum: On diagnostic copies, actual question forced on/off and a fixed true preview bit should demonstrate admitted access -> different delivered datum -> Native q2 different route -> resource consequence. Two cases suffice if both routes are physically verified; otherwise one declared revision/new reserve, not endless search.
calibration_not_candidate_learning.zero: Native choice0 maps to the inherited actual motor -1/NoQuery before consequence and has copy.minus. Keep this distinct from raw Native choice -1 and NULL.
calibration_not_candidate_learning.return: Confirm Q1 legal trace reaches its own return after q2 resource outcome; confirm Q2 nonfailure disposal and Q2 bank behavior. No retrospective calendar/reader adjustment in a reserve.
calibration_not_candidate_learning.site: No state0-as-free assumption: full RAW frame/eligibility-loop/halo/phase checks before preparing a new TC. No clearing, clock editing or learned bank transplant.

causal_trace_control_optional_strong_att.definition: A complete paired copy may receive a legal intervention after Q1 efference formation that intercepts both possible Q1 eligibility routes symmetrically, plus a verified sham of comparable input class/timing. It may not choose the route using Native choice or expected success.
causal_trace_control_optional_strong_att.target_proposal: Root proposed SEM4 barriers at ring +/-4 at seed+2; this is NOT validated by this document and requires actual RAW clearance, no interception of other routes and preserved q2 function before it counts as a selective control.
causal_trace_control_optional_strong_att.scope: Diagnostic-only. Never promote the edited control or call an inserted guard learned protection. If it fails selectivity or Native admission, preserve it and do not claim that the trace was ablated.

prospective_functional_gates.primary_local_gain: Over all12 reserved opportunities, real useful resource transfers exceed the nonfailure arm by at least2, using actual valid Native outputs and actual products. Keep the full18 totals and transition costs alongside the reserve.
prospective_functional_gates.bidirectional_use: At least one useful reduction of querying in bypass after its actual failure, and at least two useful return-to-need reserved uses with admitted query/signature and real data, without resetting between blocks.
prospective_functional_gates.history_witness: For matched actual STATE1/+Z inputs, query behavior differs between acquired need and acquired bypass/need_return histories. Locate the preceding actual return and Native Q1 bank change; phase, content and age differences remain documented.
prospective_functional_gates.causal_strength: Strong query1-credit attribution additionally needs meaningful comparison with the fixed yoked-return arm and/or a valid selective trace/sham control, with Q2 bank/decision mechanism checked. An observed joint gain can be accepted more narrowly without claiming the stronger result.
prospective_functional_gates.no_automatic_adoption: Root additionally fixes a representative conservation core, valid current access, save/reopen/new useful use, actual decisive Native replay, unused stock and public deployment. No failed requirement is silently weakened after observing outcomes.
